title: Sup-norm estimate for the action of an integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U (IMRep U n; in particular M = R.carrier is Borel with M ⊆ U, θ = R.mult is measurable and ℕ-valued with ∫_{M∩K'} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K' ⊆ U, and for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x there is a subspace Q with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q, where ξ = R.orient and Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with K ⊆ U, let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω ⊆ K, and let ε ∈ ℝ satisfy ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P (operator norm on n-covectors). Then |R.action ω| = |∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x)| ≤ ε·(∫⁻_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ ε) → |R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)| ≤ ε * (∫⁻ x in R.carrier ∩ K, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n]).toReal
